accepted.quote: However, I remain overwhelmingly opposed to the legislation as a whole.
accepted.rationale: DeLauro states overwhelming opposition to the Labor-HHS-Education appropriations bill as a whole.

accepted.quote: That includes a cut of $2 billion to Title I grants, which will push 30,000 teachers out of their classrooms and leave countless children with a worse education.
accepted.rationale: DeLauro criticizes Title I cuts as harming teachers and children, indicating support for K-12 funding.

accepted.quote: This bill eviscerates funding for employment and training by $3.3 billion--one-third below the 2026 level.
accepted.rationale: DeLauro uses negative language about employment and training cuts, indicating support for those work programs.

accepted.quote: I am glad to see the overall funding level for the National Institutes of Health is increased under this bill, especially targeted increase for research on cancer, Alzheimer's disease, ALS, diabetes, women's health, and rare diseases.
accepted.rationale: DeLauro expresses approval of increased NIH funding for specific disease research areas.
